title: Lines without a tech story look the same as before
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  3. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  4. Create an Approved work order for the case customer with a line "Line 1" and no tech story.
  5. A way to see the same kind of line before this release: the current production app, or a screenshot taken before the release.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and click the Lines tab.
  2. Look at Line 1 (its Story row and add-story prompt).
  3. Compare it with the same kind of line before this release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Line 1 looks exactly as before: the same add-story prompt and layout, no new mark and nothing missing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10051 (Story 8, Remove the tech story check-mark indicator); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S8-N1, read 8 Oct 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
